title: Specification of the recoding map
statement: Let $N$ be a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean input alphabet, let $x$ be a Boolean string, and let $s$ be a natural number. For any finite Boolean choice string $w$ whose every prefix run stays in the $s$-window, applying the recoding map to the code of the final configuration of that run gives exactly the code of the same final configuration in the $(s+1)$-window.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean input alphabet
$w$ is a finite Boolean choice string
Every prefix run determined by $w$ stays in the $s$-window
